verdict.rationale: Grafana's docs include a dedicated OpenTelemetry section covering collection of metrics, logs, traces, and profiles without vendor lock-in, and Tempo is documented to accept OpenTelemetry alongside Jaeger and Zipkin. That points to real OpenTelemetry support, but nothing in the pack shows telemetry being sent directly to an OTLP endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of OTLP ingestion endpoints (gRPC/HTTP) for direct sends, OTLP coverage for metrics and logs beyond traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
